rows.label: qst703302_msg0001
rows.name: Oh, you came. Sorry to trouble you.

rows.label: qst703302_msg0002
rows.name:
I'll get right to it. Can you see
that thing?

rows.label: qst703302_msg0003
rows.name:
The truth is... we have some history,
and it's been watching me like this.

rows.label: qst703302_msg0004
rows.name:
Would you possibly be able
to clear it away for me?

rows.label: qst703302_msg0006
rows.name:
Do you think I'd be asking
you if I could do it myself?

rows.label: qst703302_msg0007
rows.name: It doesn't look that tough, though.

rows.label: qst703302_msg0008
rows.name: Did it do something rude to you?

rows.label: qst703302_msg0010
rows.name:
Alright, alright. You just want it
to leave, right?
